توازنت (form VI)
# تَوَازَنْتُ (tawāzantu) /ta.waː.zan.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
# تَوَازَنْتَ (tawāzanta) /ta.waː.zan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
# تَوَازَنْتِ (tawāzanti) /ta.waː.zan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَازَنَ (tawāzana)
# تَوَازَنَتْ (tawāzanat) /ta.waː.za.nat/: third-person fem
